solves.reasoning: (A)(B)(C) 원문 대조: confined — microscopic — biased. 'not confined to...', 'mostly microscopic', 'our biased perspective'.
(A)(B)(C) 원문 대조: inaccessible — industrial — distorted. 'because they are inaccessible', 'industrial importance', 'not grossly distorted'.
(A)(B)(C) 원문 대조: unfamiliar — unnoticed — molecular. 'generally unfamiliar', 'go unnoticed', 'molecular analysis'.
마커 원문대조: ②"uninhabited" ≠ 원문"inhabited". 식물·초식동물이 서식하는(inhabited) 영역이 맞음.
마커 원문대조: ③"preserve" ≠ 원문"rot". 미생물이 목재를 썩히는(rot) 것이 맞음.
마커 원문대조: ②"well-known" ≠ 원문"unfamiliar". 극한 환경 생물은 낯선(unfamiliar). well-known은 반대.
빈칸 원문대조: "confined" — 'Living things are not confined to the familiar temperate realm'. 선지 ①confined.
빈칸 원문대조: "inaccessible" — 'not only because they are inaccessible'. 선지 ②inaccessible.
빈칸 원문대조: "distorted" — 'not grossly distorted'. 선지 ④distorted.
confined의 동의어. confined = limited to(~에 한정된). ch=[limited, expanded, scattered, transferred] → ①limited.
unfamiliar의 동의어. unfamiliar = 낯선. ch=[well-known, strange, accessible, ordinary] → ②strange.
microscopic의 동의어. microscopic = 극히 작은. ch=[tiny, enormous, visible, transparent] → ①tiny.
familiar의 반의어. familiar = 친숙한. ch=[common, strange, known, typical] → ②strange(낯선)이 반의어.
biased의 반의어. biased = 편향된. ch=[impartial, prejudiced, partial, influenced] → ①impartial(공정한).
(A) 'living matter' = 물질(substance). (B) 'No matter how' = 관용표현. 두 의미 다름 → D. ch 중 ④ 'D — (A)는 물질, (B)는 상관없이'.
'relating to molecules; involving the analysis of very small particles' = molecular. ch=[microscopic, industrial, molecular, temperate] → ③molecular.
어형변환: DNA __________(sequence). 'analysis of DNA sequences' — sequence → sequences(복수).
어형변환: __________(specific). 'and specifically through the analysis' — specific(형용사) → specifically(부사).
빈칸 원문대조: "make up" — 'microorganisms make up most of the total mass'. ch=[break down, give up, look for, make up] → ④make up.
빈칸 원문대조: "molecular analysis" — 'new methods of molecular analysis'. ch=[physical observation, direct measurement, molecular analysis, visual inspection] → ③molecular analysis.
